source_instruction: i am looking for a black faux leather bed frames.
query: I stopped at that little boba stand right by the mall entrance on my way in today, and the taro milk tea I got has the perfect amount of chewy boba and just the right level of sweetness, not so cloying that it makes my teeth ache halfway through the sip. There was a tiny golden retriever puppy tied to the stand’s railing while its owner waited for their drink, and it kept tilting its head at every person who walked past, wiggling its whole butt so hard its whole body shook like it was personally overjoyed to see every single stranger. I almost spilled my tea leaning down to scratch its ears, and the owner laughed and said it’s only three months old and still thinks every person it meets is there specifically to give it pets. I’ve heard that this section carries bedframes, that there are options made of faux sheepskin, that black is an available color option for those, that there are reasonably priced choices that don’t cost too much.
